result.summary: Found 1 issue: a rendering/data bug showing '€NaN delivery' for a restaurant, which appears broken to users.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery', indicating a NaN (not-a-number) value leaked into the UI due to a missing or invalid delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Validate delivery fee data before rendering; fall back to a default value (e.g., '€0.90 delivery' or 'Free delivery') or hide the price line when data is missing/NaN.
